slides.title: Landing deep.
slides.body: Hips below knees on the box means it measured how high you tucked, not how high you jumped.

slides.title: Land like you left.
slides.body: Pick the height you land on in a quarter squat. Feet flat, quiet landing. That's your box today.

slides.title: Stand tall on top.
slides.body: Hips and knees open before you come down. A crouch on the box and a hop off is half a rep.

slides.title: Step down. Always.
slides.body: It costs a second and saves your legs for the next 40 reps. Rebounds are for fresh legs and good skill.

slides.title: Lower box wins.
slides.body: A box you land quietly on trains your jump. One you scrape onto trains your tuck.
